استحقرنا (form X)
# اِسْتَحْقَرْنَا (istaḥqarnā) /is.taħ.qar.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَحْقَرَ (istaḥqara)
# اُسْتُحْقِرْنَا (ustuḥqirnā) /us.tuħ.qir.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَحْقَرَ (istaḥqara)
